    Efficient-tackle local corrections in a ray residue #

    Specialize the residue-ready sparse corrections to the last arrow of an efficient hook or cohook tackle. BGRS 8.4 supplies suffix or prefix triviality, respectively; the easy N = 2 branch additionally assumes that this selected arrow belongs to no essential contour surviving the residue.

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.exists_rayPathMap_eq_of_ne_zero {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms C] [Finite C] [IsFiniteRayCategory C] {i j : RayVertex C} (f : j.obj ⟶ i.obj) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (p : Quiver.Path i j), rayPathMap p = f

    Every nonzero morphism between the objects represented by two ray vertices has an irreducible-path presentation with exactly those vertices as its path endpoints.
